note: Combinations that are expected therapy in a stated clinical context. They never produce a Flag (PLAN P5, D-021); rules.expected_notes() returns them as informational notes for the UI. Keys use contracts.pair_key. A note is shown only when the profile has one of the listed conditions. Listing a pair here does not say the pair is safe (I7).

combinations.source: ACC/AHA guideline on dual antiplatelet therapy in coronary artery disease (2016 focused update)
combinations.text: Aspirin with clopidogrel is dual antiplatelet therapy, the usual plan after a coronary stent. It is listed here for information, not as a warning; how long to continue it is a question for the cardiologist.
